name: Bright commercial gym mirror selfie
summary: Full-body mirror selfie in a bright upscale commercial gym with cream machines, wood-look floor and an open dropped ceiling grid; everything sharp, clean Smart HDR neutrality with a mild warm cast, other members small in the background.

colors.white_balance: neutral with a mild warm cast on skin and cream equipment
colors.contrast: medium — Smart HDR retains both floor shadow and ceiling detail
notable_casts: warm cream cast across equipment and floor
faint olive tint from the ceiling structure

sources: recessed ceiling LEDs across an open dropped grid
artifacts: mild highlight clipping on glossy cream machine shells

camera.angle: mirror selfie straight-on at chest-to-eye height
camera.depth_of_field: deep — foreground floor to back wall sharp

composition.framing: full body, head to shoes, generous headroom into the ceiling grid
composition.subject_placement: centre-left third, floor plane filling the lower half
composition.foreground: polished wood-look floor and machine bases
composition.background: cream/white strength machines, dark olive ceiling beam, a few members training small and anonymous at frame right
composition.negative_space: open floor plane bottom-right and upper ceiling grid
composition.reflections: subtle screen reflection of the phone on glossy machine shells

subject_treatment.pose_type: standing neutral full-body mirror selfie, arms relaxed, one holding the phone up
subject_treatment.face_visibility: lower half of face covered by the raised phone; eyes visible
subject_treatment.gaze: at the phone screen (into the mirror)
subject_treatment.wardrobe_category: matching dark activewear set (sports bra, high-waist leggings) with light trainers

environment: bright upscale commercial gym: cream/white strength machines, wood-look plank floor, open dropped grid ceiling with recessed lights and a dark olive soffit, wide walkways, members training in the far background
effects_imperfections: mild highlight clipping on glossy cream machine surfaces
luminance noise in the darker floor wood
slight softness at the frame edges
natural skin texture retained, no smoothing

typography_overlay.shadow_or_stroke: none — reads against the dark leggings and floor behind it

reusable_prompt_fragment: bright upscale commercial gym with cream machines and wood-look floor, open grid ceiling with recessed lights, full-body mirror selfie straight-on, everything sharp to the back wall, Smart HDR neutral colour with mild warm cast, mild highlight clipping on glossy machines, faint noise in floor shadows, other members small and anonymous in the background
avoid: brand logos or identifiable faces in frame
excerlock_fit: hook or opener slide — establishes a credible, aspirational training setting in one frame
